title: Spend a day at the Sundance Film Festival
description: Choose a screening, queue with other film lovers, then step into a conversation that continues after the lights come up. Sundance’s move to Boulder in 2027 brings its independent films, filmmakers, and festival energy to a walkable Colorado city. Build your day around a film or two and leave space for an unexpected discovery.
teaser: Find a film you might never have chosen anywhere else.
goodToKnow: Sundance lists January 21–31, 2027 for its first Boulder edition. Reserve specific screenings and plan for winter weather.
whyItMightDelightYou: A festival screening lets you feel an audience respond together to a new voice on screen.
